description: Get one extraction run (an Update) by id — its status (processing | retry | succeeded | review_required | failed | out_of_scope), the schema it ran against, and its extracted result once it succeeds. Document PDF chrome (pdf_href, content_href, sections) is nested on extraction_run.document by default; pass expand_document=false to omit. Records and nested evidence live on extraction_run.result.

expand_document.description: nested document chrome on the run; defaults to true. Pass false to omit.

name: get_extraction_run
